scope: Reproduced and investigated gaps; the source-hashed line inventory is separate. Closed means the cited bounded regression is covered, not exhaustive format support.

status_definitions.closed: Reproduced gap fixed and protected by named evidence.
status_definitions.partial: Named evidence covers a bounded subset; the stated remainder remains open.
status_definitions.guarded: Unsupported operation is rejected explicitly before writing output.
status_definitions.open: Known unsupported behavior or missing acceptance coverage.
status_definitions.in_progress: Active work; not yet represented as a passing fix.

gaps.finding: Dense notes reserve space and continue without overlapping body content.
Notes retain ordered rich paragraphs, tables, owned pictures and hyperlinks.
Document defaults, basedOn inheritance, character/table styles and explicit defaults are retained.
Document-local IDs and level overrides preserve independent list sequences and repeated saves.
Independent openpyxl/python-pptx fixtures exercise styles, charts, pivots, template parts, notes and media ownership.
Open XML SDK and LibreOffice/Poppler gates validate schema and repeated-save rendering; they retain reports and actual page PNGs.
Reviewed four page images cover a rich-note document and first/even/default stories with columns; additional platforms and arbitrary scripts are not goldened.
The source-hashed coverage inventory lists every unhit instrumented line and absent file. Formula/PDF/report branches and many Office combinations remain unproven.

Strict five-command CLI exposes 67 operations; every operation has a committed scenario. Independently authored expectations cover multi-format edits plus creation, modification and removal of Word tables, TOCs, bookmark references, threaded comments, picture wrapping and positioned frames.
All six header/footer variants and notes retain owned image data; replacement/reorder does not overwrite shared payloads.
Imports and writes follow main/styles/notes/settings relationships instead of assuming fixed package filenames.
Drawing links, chart transforms, pivot cache attributes and font-property ordering produce schema-valid output.
Pixel-to-column conversion follows the maximum-digit-width formula; untouched source precision and hidden/grouped/widthless column properties survive edits.
Rich text, scalar font/color edits, hard breaks, paragraphs, templates, transitions, chart transforms and axis IDs survive import/save.
A supported Choice or Fallback is selected once in all modeled Word stories.
Page numbering, grids, borders, custom columns, gutter, line-number settings and section history survive unrelated edits and cloning.
Referenced built-ins absent from an imported style catalog are written with their known parent styles.
LF/CRLF/CR serialize as real Word breaks, tabs survive, and typed page/column breaks remain distinct.
Replacing the viewport triggers layout before painting so its extent is initialized and later pages are visible.
A document revision captured before asynchronous save prevents later edits from being marked clean or closed by an earlier upload.
Preview follows owning parts for notes and workbook order/names, preserves tabs/breaks and explicit false formatting, including package-root main parts.
An independently authored exact output manifest is cleaned narrowly before producers and verified after generation; corruption controls reject absent groups and unexpected files.

Imported altChunk block references, original payload identity, content types and owning-part relationships survive edits, moves and repeated exports. This is preservation; Quds does not render the embedded content.

Native block and inline content-control boundaries preserve original metadata, nesting, empty content, aliases, tags, IDs and end-run properties through inside/adjacent edits, cloning, history and three saves. The original loss probe now requires preservation in the passing gate.
gaps.limits: Supported block controls contain ordinary editable body/table-cell/note blocks; inline controls remain within their paragraph, including headers. Unsupported row/cell wrappers, block controls in paragraph-only header/comment models, inline drawing containers, controls inside hyperlink/revision wrappers, invalid nesting and an inline control split across paragraphs reject explicitly. Content-control-specific UI and data-binding semantics are not implemented.

gaps.finding: Typed native bookmark endpoints retain source IDs, names, optional attributes, order and exact ranges, including overlapping and cross-paragraph ranges. Insertion, formatting, paragraph split, cloning, clipboard, undo/redo and three-save tests preserve their identities; generated heading bookmarks avoid native collisions.
gaps.limits: Paragraph-external native endpoints reject at import. Unpaired/cross-story or duplicate native IDs/names reject before package mutation. Copying a native range into the same document requires identity reassignment; duplicate identities are guarded rather than silently rewritten.

gaps.finding: Native comment replies and resolved state join through final comment paragraph IDs independently of numeric comment IDs, including reverse source order and mixed-case hexadecimal IDs. Three cycles retain the anchors and source rendering.
The script refuses a sheet rename if formulas, names, charts or pivots refer to it; full reference rewriting is not implemented.
The script refuses slide reorder when presentation sections would also need rewriting.
Column conversion defaults to maximum-digit-width7 and accepts an explicit metric in helpers; normal-style font measurement is not automatic.
LibreOffice repeated-cycle stability is verified; Microsoft Office visual equivalence and interactive native UI behavior are not certified.

Imported documents without a style catalog retain sparse paragraph and run properties. Saving no longer invents global fonts or paragraph after-spacing that changes rendering; explicit edits still export.

gaps.area: Note source whitespace and marker formatting
gaps.finding: Imported note separator whitespace, including no space, spaces and tabs, survives exactly. Note-mark run properties retain their original XML or absence. XML space inheritance is respected. Newly created notes retain a conventional superscript marker and one separator.
gaps.limits: This original regression covers conventional leading automatic markers. FID-040 extends exported preservation to arbitrary source placement and absence; the canvas still uses conventional note-label layout.

gaps.finding: Cloning a section reserves existing revision-history IDs and allocates a distinct stable ID without changing the historical section payload. Original and cloned host exports validate independently.

gaps.area: Imported table border absence and inheritance
gaps.finding: Source table properties retain absent, inherited and explicit nil borders distinctly. Disabling inherited borders writes an explicit override; new tables keep their existing defaults.
gaps.limits: Untouched unmodeled per-edge source XML is retained, but the editable model has one border/color/width tuple. A deliberate border edit emits six uniform edges; independent per-edge editing is not implemented.

gaps.area: Picture wrap distance and omitted attributes
gaps.finding: Picture wrap distances retain zero and sub-eight-point values. Imported omitted attributes remain absent, while explicit zero and later explicit assignments remain observable; visual copies preserve the baseline and edit intent.

gaps.area: Split identity and style namespace editing
gaps.finding: Splitting a paragraph does not duplicate its bookmark identity or restart marker; undo/redo remains stable. Style edits bind generated XML properties to the Word namespace even when an imported w prefix refers to another namespace.

gaps.area: Intermediate list clear and empty format range
gaps.finding: Clearing inherited or direct list numbering exports an explicit suppression override that survives style refresh, clone/history and three save/reopen cycles. Reapplying a list or numbered style restores numbering. Empty script formatting ranges fail with an indexed step diagnostic before replacing output.

gaps.area: CrispCloud Office search fidelity and bounds
gaps.finding: Search follows relocated main/story parts, note references, workbook and slide order, used shared strings and speaker notes. Strict OOXML namespaces are recognized; external and escaping relationships are rejected; input and emitted UTF-8 text share bounded processing rules.

gaps.area: Actual host outputs and coverage provenance
gaps.finding: The host requires all valid captured DOCX outputs listed in the output manifest, then independently validates them with Open XML SDK. Fresh Office LCOV and engine VM reports list unhit instrumented lines, absent files and current source hashes. Helpers reject malformed records, missing source paths and out-of-range line numbers; clean-directory collection is required because same-length stale input cannot be detected from coverage alone.

gaps.area: Imported note marker position and absence
gaps.finding: Imported note-body markers are explicit zero-width model objects. Missing, nonleading, later-paragraph, multiple and table-first markers retain exact order, kind and run properties through range edits, split/clone and repeated exports. New notes keep their conventional generated prefix.
gaps.limits: This is export preservation. Unconventional marker positions are not replicated by the conventional canvas note-label layout. Explicit whole-note text replacement discards contained rich structure and retains only its first marker as a leading marker; structure-preserving edits use range-edit APIs.

gaps.area: CrispCloud note commands and actual ribbon edits
gaps.finding: Word Insert tab and menu expose localized Footnote/Endnote commands and open the editable notes pane. Note editing preserves entered whitespace, respects read-only mode and supports undo/redo. A real ribbon heading/paragraph/note/picture workflow validates three actual host uploads and reopens with independent XML/media assertions.

Word, Sheet and Slide canvases own and dispose decoded images. Pending decodes finishing after closure release their image and do not repaint a disposed render object. Deterministic pending/ready disposal controls and the actual host repeated reopen workflow pass.

gaps.area: Unsupported native Word container and range operations
gaps.finding: Unsupported SDT hierarchies/container placements, inline-control paragraph splits, paragraph-external bookmarks and invalid/duplicated bookmark identities reject explicitly. Export preflight runs before package changes; rejected script operations preserve an existing output file. Richer editing semantics for these cases remain unimplemented.

gaps.area: Rich run editing and native inline fields
gaps.finding: Coalescing, cloning, deletion, links and citations retain sparse styles, note tokens and native inline field metadata. Native citations no longer replace surrounding paragraph content. Field dispatch matches instruction commands, not words within quoted arguments.

gaps.area: TOC cached content and source formatting
gaps.finding: Page-number suppression, including native partial ranges, survives repeated exports without stripping trailing heading numerals. Export does not mutate live paragraph tabs.

gaps.area: Rich table merge and structural undo
gaps.finding: Merge retains ordered paragraphs, pictures, frames, nested tables and drawings; row/cell snapshots retain properties without aliasing. Editor history reuses live identities so later commands remain attached after replay.

gaps.area: Picture accessibility metadata and leading column breaks
gaps.finding: Native picture title and description remain independent of display name. A middle column break does not suppress an explicit leading column break.

Paragraph and margin dialogs retain fractional values, imported tab alignment and leaders, explicit zero and unedited properties. No-op Apply remains clean; selected and auxiliary-story edits are covered through real host controls.

gaps.area: Structural scripts and independent edit goldens
gaps.finding: Authored XML, three committed scripts and semantic JSON expectations cover create/edit/remove transitions across three save/reopen cycles. Invalid structures and late step failures preserve existing output.

Tracked revisions bind to the actual paragraph across body, header/footer, note and comment stories; imports, serialization and accept/reject no longer redirect to unrelated body indexes. Native export splits coalesced runs at exact revision boundaries and retains valid hyperlink/inline-field nesting.
gaps.limits: Imported note revisions resolve safely. Notes-pane whole-text replacement, structural/formatting changes and overlapping tracked ranges do not yet have complete native change-tracking semantics.

gaps.finding: Bibliography export uses hardcoded duplicate custom XML paths and can overwrite unrelated custom XML. Native author containers and rich source metadata need independent preservation checks.
Simple inline native fields retain instruction, lock and dirty flags, and are atomic during supported edits. Arbitrarily nested, multi-run complex fields still need a range-aware model.

Text insertion, paragraph splitting and overlapping edits within already tracked spans need explicit range transformation coverage; paragraph identity alone cannot establish character-range correctness.

gaps.area: Imported sparse styles after catalog introduction
gaps.finding: Introducing a heading/TOC style catalog no longer applies new-document spacing defaults to unrelated imported paragraphs; explicit defaults and overrides still cascade.
Independent controls reject dangling comment references, broken TOC targets, explicit false cantSplit, incorrect image relationship type and missing native field boundaries.

Late invalid arguments no longer partially mutate run formats, images, cells, stories or sections. Native cached fields reject partial ranges; TOC bookmark targets are unique, empty REF caches are explicit and visibility updates clear partial omission.
Replacing laid-out pages or compact mode invalidates layout, recalculating viewport extent and geometry before painting.
